video_summary.description: User navigates puzzle menu, adjusts puzzle size to 9 pieces, selects "Without Rotations" mode, generates puzzle, and starts gameplay

overall_flow: User scrolls puzzle size selector from initial value to 9 pieces
User taps Generate Puzzle button to create puzzle with size=9 and mode=without_rotations
Puzzle game screen loads with 9 scattered pieces ready for gameplay
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: User begins interacting with puzzle size selector on the menu
Step 2: User scrolls puzzle size selector through values 4→2→4→6
Step 3: User continues scrolling size selector to reach 9 pieces
Step 4: User taps Generate Puzzle button to initiate puzzle creation
Step 5: Puzzle game starts with 9 pieces displayed on gameplay screen
